title: Add error logging to pack uninstall --purge
description:
**Severity: MEDIUM**

**File**: `cmd/cordumctl/pack.go:383,386`

**Issue**: `_ = client.deleteWorkflow(...)` and `_ = client.deleteSchema(...)` silently swallow errors during purge cleanup. Operators have no way to know which resources weren't cleaned up.

**Fix**: Log warnings on failure so operators know which resources weren't cleaned up. Example: `if err := client.deleteWorkflow(...); err != nil { slog.Warn("purge: failed to delete workflow", "error", err) }`
definitionOfDone: Both deleteWorkflow and deleteSchema error paths log warnings via slog.Warn
Log messages include the resource name and error detail

implementationPlan.description: Replace `_ = client.deleteWorkflow(ctx, wfID)` on line 383 with `if err := client.deleteWorkflow(ctx, wfID); err != nil { slog.Warn("purge: failed to delete workflow", "workflow_id", wfID, "error", err) }`.

Replace `_ = client.deleteSchema(ctx, schemaID)` on line 386 with `if err := client.deleteSchema(ctx, schemaID); err != nil { slog.Warn("purge: failed to delete schema", "schema_id", schemaID, "error", err) }`.
Run existing tests with `go test ./cmd/cordumctl/...` to verify no regressions.
